description: This Java source file defines the class IdValidator, which provides functionality to validate IDs against a specified regular expression pattern, including methods for instantiation, validation, and retrieving the reason for invalidity.

classes.name: IdValidator
classes.description: A final immutable class that validates an ID string against a provided regex pattern. It implements the Validator interface and offers methods to check validity and retrieve reasons for invalid IDs.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new IdValidator instance with a specified ID and regex pattern.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided ID matches the regex pattern; returns true if valid, false otherwise, and sets an explanatory reason if invalid.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the reason why the ID is invalid if applicable.
